name: rumi-platform
description: Rumi - AI Teaching Assistant for WhatsApp. Open-source platform for deploying AI-powered educational chatbots.

scripts.build:portal: npm ci --prefix portal && npm run build --prefix portal && rm -rf dashboard/portal-frontend/dist && cp -r portal/dist dashboard/portal-frontend/dist && npm install --prefix dashboard
scripts.prepare: if [ -f scripts/qa/link-engine.sh ] && command -v bash >/dev/null; then bash scripts/qa/link-engine.sh --quiet || true; fi
scripts.qa:test: bash scripts/qa/engine-bridge.test.sh && E2E_NIETE_CHECKOUT=. E2E_NIETE_SHA=HEAD bash .claude/qa/engine/tests/run-all.sh && python3 .claude/qa/shared/test_niete_sandbox_driver.py && node .claude/qa/shared/test_app_redirect_case.js && bash bot/scripts/e2e/local-db.test.sh && bash bot/scripts/e2e/portal-demo-seed.test.sh && bash bot/scripts/e2e/sandbox-copy.test.sh && bash bot/scripts/e2e/refresh-views.test.sh && bash bot/scripts/e2e/local-db-linux.test.sh && bash scripts/qa/e2e-web.test.sh && bash scripts/dev-portal.test.sh && bash bot/scripts/e2e/local-stack-retarget.test.sh && node bot/scripts/e2e/local-r2.test.js && bash bot/scripts/e2e/local-stack-restart.test.sh && bash bot/scripts/e2e/local-stack-ports.test.sh && python3 .claude/qa/shared/test_niete_training_db.py && python3 .claude/qa/shared/test_niete_registration_db.py && python3 .claude/qa/shared/test_harness_users_columns.py && node .claude/qa/shared/test_registration_feature_name_gate.js && node .claude/qa/shared/test_language_feature.js && bash bot/scripts/e2e/local-stack-env.test.sh && bash bot/scripts/e2e/provision-local-keys.test.sh && bash bot/scripts/e2e/provision-local-modules.test.sh && bash scripts/qa/test_niete_e2e_schedule.sh && python3 .claude/qa/shared/niete_coaching_db_reset_conversations.test.py
